name: @hobo/provider-vercel-blob
description: HoBo Vercel Blob binding of the ephemeral-state port: one private blob per key holding a protobuf-JSON record (value, incarnation, revision, expiry), compare-and-set through ETag-conditional writes (ifMatch), putIfAbsent through create-only writes, conditional deletes, increment as a bounded read-and-CAS loop, lazy TTL expiry with a bounded list-and-purge, a meter of Blob's simple and advanced operations, and the BLOB_STORE_ID + Vercel OIDC environment helper.
